groups.defect: Backup-code verification uses timing-variable indexOf/string comparisons in both the login and disable-2FA paths.
groups.rationale: Both report the same comparison mistake at separate verification sites, each requiring an edit. Their proposed case normalization does not report case sensitivity as a defect and therefore does not link the uppercase-code suggestion.

groups.defect: Non-atomic backup-code consumption permits concurrent reuse, and consumed entries accumulate as nulls without exhausted-code handling.
groups.rationale: Both report the same read-modify-write race in authorize(). The second additionally reports null accumulation and failure to report exhausted codes as missing, which the merged comment must preserve.
